title: diphasiastrum zeilleri var. polystachyum
intro: Diphasiastrum zeilleri var. polystachyum, commonly known as Polystachya Club Moss, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the genus Diphasiastrum, characterized by its forked and branching stems. This plant is used in traditional medicine to promote respiratory health and treat conditions such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs, due to its expectorant and bronchodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Diphasiastrum zeilleri var. polystachyum include its ability to relieve congestion, reduce inflammation, and soothe the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
